info.name: Amazon S3 Control Access Control Table Buckets API

params.name: prefix
params.description: The prefix of the table buckets.

params.name: continuationToken
params.description: ContinuationToken indicates to S3 Tables that the list is being continued with a token.

params.name: maxBuckets
params.description: The maximum number of table buckets to return in the list.

items.docs: Lists table buckets for your account. Returns a list of table buckets that you have access to.
Creates a table bucket. A table bucket is a resource that you can use to create and store tables. Each table bucket can contain tables in Apache Iceberg format stored as Apache Parquet files.

params.name: tableBucketARN
params.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the table bucket.

items.docs: Gets details about a table bucket. Returns information about the specified table bucket including its name, ARN, owner, and creation date.

params.name: tableBucketARN
params.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the table bucket.

items.docs: Deletes a table bucket. The table bucket must be empty (all tables and namespaces must be deleted first) before it can be deleted.
